title: Trace a perceptual-hash candidate from pixels to decision
description: Switch inputs to see which stage owns normalization, retrieval, verification, and failure handling. Select a node to inspect its contract.

nodes.label: Query image
nodes.detail: The original bytes and metadata are retained long enough to reproduce preprocessing and verify a candidate decision.

nodes.label: Normalizer
nodes.detail: Decodes safely, fixes declared orientation and color rules, and produces the exact pixels expected by the selected hash algorithm.

nodes.label: Perceptual hasher
nodes.detail: Creates a fixed-width signature. Algorithm name, width, implementation version, and preprocessing version travel with the value.

nodes.label: Binary index
nodes.detail: Returns stored signatures inside a declared Hamming radius. Index recall and lag are measured independently from hash quality.

nodes.label: Candidate verifier
nodes.detail: Uses stronger visual evidence, metadata, geometry, or a trained model to reject collisions and explain the remaining match.

nodes.label: Review or product action
nodes.detail: Applies policy with evidence, confidence, and an appeal or recovery path appropriate to the action's impact.

nodes.label: Labeled evaluation set
nodes.detail: Contains representative positives and hard negatives. It is refreshed as content, transformations, and abuse behavior change.

scenarios.label: Benign resize
scenarios.summary: A resized and recompressed copy follows the same normalization and lands close to its source signature.
scenarios.result: The hash retrieves a candidate; the verifier confirms that the visual evidence and provenance support the product's near-duplicate definition.

scenarios.label: Aggressive crop
scenarios.summary: A crop removes much of the global structure used by the current hash, so the source falls outside the configured radius.
scenarios.result: This is a false negative for a crop-tolerant product. Add crop-aware retrieval or another model rather than widening one global threshold until unrelated images flood the candidate set.

scenarios.label: Visual collision
scenarios.summary: An unrelated image with similar broad structure enters the Hamming-radius candidate set.
scenarios.result: Candidate retrieval behaved as configured. The verifier must reject the collision before an enforcement action, and the labeled pair should enter threshold evaluation.

scenarios.label: Index lag
scenarios.summary: A known source signature has been stored but has not reached the serving index generation used by the query.
scenarios.result: A correct hash cannot retrieve absent data. Monitor ingestion-to-search lag, expose index generation, and retry or reconcile according to the product's freshness contract.
